description: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, resistance heated; hot isostatic presses

predecessors.note: Before 2022 hot isostatic presses were reported inside HS 851410 (resistance heated furnaces). The continuous long series is at HS-4 8514.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
